I will say that I do live in a very dry area that also can be very cold (Colorado) so I will see how it goes over winter when my skin really gets bad. I recommend this to others with dry skin but I actually think the formula, the texture and how it goes on will work for any skin type.

avis.titre: Absolutely Heaven Sent — My Skin Has Never Felt This Soft
avis.texte: This stuff is HEAVEN SENT. Seriously, throw everything else away because this is the moisturizer. I’ve tried plenty of lotions and creams, but this one has completely changed my expectations for what a moisturizer can do. The hydration is incredible. I can genuinely go 2–3 days without applying lotion again after using this, and my skin still feels soft and moisturized. My elbows are probably the best example — they feel like they were given a completely new start. They went from being rough and dry to unbelievably soft. The texture surprised me because it’s much more watery and lightweight than I expected from a concentrated cream. It spreads really easily and doesn’t feel like you’re putting a thick, heavy layer of product on your skin. It does have a somewhat unusual scent. I would describe it as slightly medicinal, almost like the smell of a coated tablet/pill — not a capsule, specifically. Thankfully, the scent isn’t very strong and doesn’t bother me once it’s applied. The biggest thing for me is that it actually lasts. I don’t feel like I have to constantly reapply it throughout the day just to keep my skin from getting dry again. If you have extremely dry, rough skin or you’re tired of lotions that feel nice for five minutes and then disappear, try this. My skin feels genuinely transformed, and this has easily become one of my favorite moisturizers.

I tried elimination diets, swapped every product in our home for non-toxic and irritant-free versions, I tried every other generic tip in the book. We saw the doctor multiple times about it and they always just prescribed us a steroid cream, while admitting openly that it wouldn’t actually heal anything (and could even make it worse long-term), but would just manage symptoms. Somewhere in my learning journey I read about ceramides. I researched to find the cleanest ceramide cream out there and this is what I found. This is EWG certified, which is amazing if you’re looking for clean ingredients. avis.titre: Better than Aestura. It is an Absolute MUST for Dry Climates!
avis.texte: At first I hesitated to buy this because I already owned Aestura’s moisturizer (Illiyoon’s sister brand), which had already surpassed all other moisturizers I’ve tried. But I heard amazing things about Iliyoon and because it was so affordable I decided to purchase it. To my surprise, the Iliyoon hydrates and seals in moisture better than Aestura. For reference, I have dry skin and live in a very dry environment (Colorado). It is thicker in consistency and is more occlusive than Aestura, yet it doesn’t feel sticky and still absorbs just as easily. While using Aestura I’d still develop a few dry patches on my face. But using Illiyoon my entire face is extremely hydrated and the moisturizer acts like a vacuum seal on my face that retains that moisture 24/7. Never in my life has my face felt so healthy and hydrated. As a note, Aestura is still a great moisturizer. But Illiyoon does an exceptional job at addressing my dry and sensitive skin needs. From now on I’m using Illiyoon as my primary moisturizer and Aestura as my backup. Edit: I’ve been using Illiyoon for over a month and my skin is the healthiest it’s ever been. I’m shocked to see that my face glows now after so many years of dull looking skin. I cannot emphasize enough how much a moisturized, healthy skin barrier matters. I will only be using Illiyoon from now on.

avis.texte: Compré esta crema buscando reparar mi piel tras pasarme con el uso de retinol, y cumplió su función de maravilla en solo unos días. Calma la rojez y elimina la resequedad de inmediato. No tiene ningún tipo de olor, lo cual agradezco.El único detalle es que para el día la siento un poco pesada en mi zona T (tengo piel mixta), por lo que prefiero usarla exclusivamente en mi rutina de noche o en zonas muy resecas del cuerpo. Si tienes piel extremadamente seca o sensible, te fascinará. Si eres de piel grasa, te sugiero usar muy poca cantidad.
Possibly best moisturizer. Not too thin and goes on smoothly def rebuying

I needed a moisturizer. I was looking through quite a few them. I read the reviews. I decided to give it a try but the small size. Just in case. I actually love it. It’s not greasy. Absorbs well, skin feels good. I just bought the larger size. I used expensive moisturizers as well. But this one it’s pretty good. I have normal to dry skin. I definitely recommend it.

For me it is the best moisturizer in the world, my skin is very dry, not even the most famous creams like CERAVE and EUCERIN helped me, at most they only hydrated me for 2 hours, but this cream exceeds expectations, it keeps my face hydrated 24 hours a day, I recommend it. I've been using it for a week now.

Read the ingredient list. This product is made up of so much carrying oil that the lavender scent is practically undetectable. If you love the smell of almond oil, however, feel free to proceed. Buyers remember to read the ingredients list, which I failed to do. Lavender is the last item, which means it has the lowest amount relative to everything that’s listed before it. There are better products. If you’re looking for a massage oil that actually has substantial lavender in it, choose one with lavender as the second or third listed ingredient. Because I opened this, I can’t return it. Ugh. 2 stars because the oil feels nice on the skin.

Love love love this moisturizer. My skin is very sensitive and dry and combination. I had tried so many moisturizer. But this moisturizer is good. Worth of every dollar. Really loved it. Use it regularly and skin feel so smooths. A bit thicker but it works so welll

avis.titre: Huge bottle and great moisturizer for winter
avis.texte: Oh my goodness this bottle is huge. I was expecting a tiny little bottle like the travel lotions you get at the store, but I kid you not this bottle is the size of my hand if not bigger. It also does a really great job moisturizing my drier skin during the winter. I have tried so many other Korean moisturizers for my winter skin and this is the only one that has worked. One thing to note is that they did put some stickers on the bottle that covered up the Korean and translated things like the volume of the bottle, the ingredients, and the description into English, which was really helpful. Great moisturizer for drier skin, especially on a budget!

i like it, but its a bit too moisturizing (i have combination skin type) there is A LOT of product tho, so its definitely worth the money! i expected it to be much smaller, so this was a pleasant surprise.

avis.titre: Product works well, a little difference what I'm used too but no issues
avis.texte: This was recommended to me from a reddit user and upon using for 3 months, no issue on normal skin. Product seems good, different smell and thicker than what I remember it used to be. I like this product better beauty of Joseon because it doesn't have an oil/glow effect at the end, it does but not too shinny. The product is sweat resistant as I used for the gym and it stay on well. drawback is it like a little oily once I hit past the 12 hour mark. I recommend daily cleanse and don't leave this product on too long. Male, 40, Normal skin, oily on T-zone areas I usually order mine from YesStyle but this time I took and chance and ordered from Amazon. Packaging is in English and I tried to reach out the company but their email keeps on getting invalid email address. Most likely will not order again since I can't get a hold of the company. Order was fulled by Amazon via "ILLIYOON Official"

avis.titre: Deceitful tubes so big for such a small quantity of cream
avis.texte: The product itself is not so bad but it’s very deceiving when they give you this large tube of ceramide concentrated cream 6.7 ounces it sure doesn’t seem like the 6.7 ounces why are you such a big container when there’s not that much cream in it so I’m disappointed on the quantity for what you pay for

I have sensitive, combination skin and needed a fragrance-free moisturizer that wouldn’t clog pores or cause redness. This cream has a lightweight, creamy texture that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or sticky. I love this and will be ordering more.

avis.titre: Great size and product for price!
avis.texte: I really like this product! My skin has a noticeable difference and it is great for sensitive skin. Will be repurchasing. The size is awesome for the price.

So I have probably purchased this moisturizer nine maybe 10 times. It is my absolute favorite facial moisturizer. it’s thick but spreads easily , and sinks into the skin. There is no fragrance. The ingredients are good it’s a giant bottle I’ve never had breakouts or any negative effects from using this and I have very sensitive skin. This is an all-around amazing moisturizer. I’ve used it on my hands, my face, my feet, my legs. You can use this anywhere and it lasts for months, unless your like me and put this everywhere, even then it lasts a long time.
Absorbs pretty well, moisturizing, and bigger than I thought it would be, but definitely not lightweight. I think it’s good for repairing the skin barrier.

avis.titre: nice... but not for my skin type
avis.texte: tldr: has ingredients that sit on my skin instead of absorb into it; broke out as a result edit: i have now found out cetyl ethylhexanoate was the cause of my breakouts! i have dehydrated oily sensitive skin. i saw people say this moisturizer is gentle and moisturizing on tiktok and i decided i'd give it a try. i like the cooling effect it gives and it makes my skin feel really soft. but after a while i realized it leaves a greasy feeling to my face and i started breaking out. i researched the ingredients and i found it has Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate and Cetyl Ethylhexanoate which i'm pretty sure were the causes to my breakout. maybe the other versions of this moisturizer don't have this but i don't want to take my chances and buy again, i'm using this for my body instead :)

I bought based on a recommendation by Kelly Driscoll on Youtube! This is such an amazing moisturizer that's great for sensitive, damaged skin! It is not scented and a little goes a long way. My face stays moisturized for hours when I use this and even when I wake up in the morning. I have a greasy t-zone and when I use this my face isn't greasy at all! It's not too thick or too light, it's in the middle and not too occlusive where your face can't breathe. I've been using this for almost a month now and this will definitely become my staple moisturizer. I also used this on my eczema and my skin felt so moisturized and it stopped itching 🙌🏾 It arrived on time and in perfect condition! 5/5
I bought a bunch of Korean beauty products to try out and this one is a repeat purchase. It's soothing and moisturizing and has really helped my skin

Once I saw this was Amore Pacific, I immediately got curious and wanted to try. First of all...for the price, this is a bang for your buck. When I first saw pictures, I had no idea that it would be twice as big as I interpreted. I was even more shocked when this actually yielded some great results. My face stays moisturized throughout the whole night and I am so so so happy to wake up to baby skin! Now i don’t know if it’s due to the combination of products I use that just happen to go well together but so far, I feel this truly works for me.
Very very big size. 16.9 ounces. This product is extra hydrating and absorbs very well. It makes my skin feel extremely hydrated.

At 30 I’ve been loyal to tretinoin for 4 years and I can’t deny it transformed my skin. Less acne, faded sun spots, smoother texture, softer forehead lines… but every morning still felt like a battle. Around my acne scars I’d get those tiny dry, flaky patches. SPF would cling. Makeup would separate. My skin looked textured even though it was improving underneath. I kept trying the “remove dead skin” approach… warm water, thinking about exfoliating pads in the morning but my skin didn’t need more exfoliation. It needed support. Then I started reaching for this moisturizer. The ILLIYOON Ceramide ATO Concentrate Cream became my “prep before everything” step. Instead of scrubbing flakes off, I press a layer into damp skin and wait a few minutes before SPF. The difference Less tightness Less visible flaking around acne marks Makeup sits smoother Skin feels calm instead of stripped And for those fine crow’s feet? It didn’t erase them (nothing realistic does overnight), but hydrated skin made them look softer and less obvious. If you’re using tretinoin and your makeup keeps exposing every dry patch… maybe your skin isn’t asking for another exfoliating pad. Maybe it’s asking for moisture + barrier support.
I love the thickness of this cream. it’s my second repurchase and it’s so good for my dry skin, not sticky at all.

On 0.04% tretinoin now and my cerave lotion wasn't enough so I decided to try this after hearing Kelly Driscoll talk about it. Its thick and moisturizing so I only like using at night. I have slightly oily skin but now with tret its normal. This is a great price since most Asian moisturizers come in tiny amounts and for this price you're getting almost 7 ounces. No smell, nothing Irritating. This will last me months at this size so yay.
Really great for dry skin or for cold weather. The bottle is bigger than I expected. Overall, one of my top favorite moisturizers!
This made me breakout into a itchy rash on my face down to my neck I cannot recommend this product. Who knows where they get it?

avis.titre: Works for hormonal acne / sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've been using this moisturizer for almost two months now (I don't like to review when I just get the product, but when I use it for a while). I really like it because it's cheap and good. I have hormonal acne/ sensitive skin and this works really well because it's non grease.
Received this today and it’s a pretty large tube, but only 1/2 full as indicated in picture and still sealed. I hope it’s good though!

avis.titre: The best moisturizer I've ever come across!
avis.texte: I have oily skin and it's very difficulty to find a moisturizer that doesn't doesn't leave me greasy by the end of the day. Pros: - Lightweight and sinks into the skin. This cream doesn't sit on top of your skin like most moisturizers. It actually sinks in and doesn't leave a greasy film. - Contains visible ceramide capsules that bursts when you apply - Layers well under makeup - Affordable!!

This is NOT a dupe for Soon Jung 2x barrier intensive cream. Since they reformulated, I’ve been trying to find a replacement. My skin likes the older watery consistency. This is a thick cream that you have to work into your skin. Does not leave you dewy at all. Disappointed.
I’ve been using this moisturizer for two years and was always happy with it. But the one I bought this time has a different texture, and ever since I started using it, I’ve been getting rashes.

When I tried it for a couple days, my skin went from clear to becoming acne filled in such a short period of time due to this product! It was heavy on the skin and it wasn’t as effective as I would have wanted it to have been. There was no hydration that came from this. It only made my skin even more dry. There was no “glow.” It made your face look like you dumped a whole gallon of oil onto your face.
The texture of this moisturizer is super thick but I am liking it so far.

avis.titre: Really bummed. Caused me a severe reaction
avis.texte: I had really high hopes for this moisturizer. I used it once and had a horrible reaction to it. It was like a chemical burn. If you try this, maybe test it on a small place first. It’s been a week and my face and neck are still recovering. 😣

I expected better from this korean brand. It’s so difficult to find the actual ingredients-and when I received the product and I read the long list, it has butelyne glycol, dimethicone, canola oil which is just sad-too much ingredients and the scent is light but unnatural for me. Do not buy.
For the high price, you'd think it'd be completely filled, but it wasn't. However, the product does feels good. Just extremely disappointed.
Im sure this moisturizer is good but wtf how is it 1/2 empty when it got shipped. I literally got it today and opened it to see it was 1/2 gone. Anyone else have the same problem?
This made my skin worse. Red and irritated. I then noticed that it has many tiny insoluble white particles in there. Not sure if it’s supposed to be there, or a bad batch

avis.titre: Wonderful Ceramide Cream - Very Smooth - Excellent Barrier Restoring Ingredients
avis.texte: (Ingredients list is at the bottom of this review.) I really love the Illiyoon Ceramide Ato Concentrate Cream face moisturizer soothing for sensitive skin 100ml, 3.4 Fl Oz. It's an excellent barrier restoring and maintaining cream, which my skin really loves. In the past, I avoided this cream because my skin didn't react well to ingredients that contained the word "siloxane". It was a bummer, because I had heard that this cream was pretty amazing. Lo and behold, Illiyoon reformulated and removed the "siloxane" ingredients, so I was very keen to give the new formulation a try; And I was not at all disappointed. This is a thick, white cream, which contains tiny micro-capsules. The capsules burst and blend into the formulation as soon as you begin to rub the product into the skin. There is never any grit or texture left behind. In fact, this cream glides onto the skin very smoothly, and it leaves a lovely smooth, glowy, hydrated, healthy-looking finish. It sinks into the skin nicely, but it leaves a much-needed, lasting layer of moisture and hydration present on the surface of the skin. The packaging is a typical, white, plastic squeeze tube with a flip-top cap. This cream is a great value for money, because very little goes a very long way. There is no scent to this cream. My skin does so well with Ceramides, and I love several Ceramide creams. However, this is definitely one of my new favorites. I use it quite often in my rotation, and I will definitely continue using it. I ex

The listing indicates that this is a new creation of face creams that has recently been tested with promising results. I decided to become one of their test subjects and am trying out this cream on my face to see if I can replicate the findings that are listed. SO FAR, I am impressed with the results. My face has stayed moist between showers that I take each day so I can attest to at least 24 hours of sealed in moisture in various conditions that I spend my days bot inside and outside. I have not detected any scent that this cream has. It immediately absorbs into my skin leaving no residue. I do recommend this product when it becomes available.

I really like that it’s unscented and the texture is beautiful, but my skin did not agree with it. I have never had a reaction to skincare so I was definitely surprised when I started developing a stinging red rash after application. The reaction was mild at first and I didn’t realize it was due to the moisturizer until I had been using it for a few days. It’s much worse now and painful. Be cautious if you have sensitive skin!!

avis.titre: It is so worth the price
avis.texte: I wasn’t to sure about buying this as it is expensive for lotion. I tired a little from my brother for a couple of days and bought my own. It is not greasy even though it feels like it when you put it on. It’s thick but not if that make sense. You know when you put it on it’s going to feel amazing. I get little break outs on the back on my arms and got tired of really thick lotion that made me feel greasy and can only put it on at bedtime. This lotion here I can put it on at all time and my skin feels amazing. The picture of the opened lotion is about almost two months worth of usage, so you definitely get your moneys worth.

For dry skin.. absolutely was not worth the hype. It first feels luxuriously moisturizing. Dries down to a dry residue film. Felt thick and dry around my eyes. Pastey! That’s how it feels! Used on my body instead, broke me out on my chest and back. No no no… glow for five minutes, enough for an influencer to influence you, yeah. But trash… The photo with the dry looking hand, is what it actually dries down to…

​"I absolutely loved this cream. My 10-year-old daughter had an irritation on her face, and this cream visibly helped improve her skin. I started using it after I reintroduced tretinoin into my routine. It irritated my skin and caused a bit of peeling, and this cream helped me too. Totally recommended. This is my new go-to cream for the days I use tretinoin."

avis.titre: I can’t say enough good things about this cream!
avis.texte: Illiyoon Ceramide Ato Concentrate Cream is hands down the best moisturizer I’ve ever used in my life. I’m 46 and have very sensitive and chronically dry skin. I have tried everything from Cerave to Vanicream to Clinique. Nothing has ever touched my dryness until I bought this. I bought this almost 2 months ago and it has made a dramatic difference in my skin and dryness. My skin is so soft, plump, and moisturized. I’m shocked by how well this moisturizes. It is very thick and a little goes a long way. I only use a dime size amount for my face and neck.This cream is now my holy grail. There is a reason why it has so many good reviews. I pray they never change the formula. I will repurchase again and again!

I have bought this product multiple times, and will continue to buy it! It’s not too thick or too thin. Great for sensitive skin! Have used in the morning with and without makeup and it always makes my skin look amazing! Even my husband loves it!

avis.titre: Su formulación permite que tú rostro esté 100% hidratada.
avis.texte: Esta crema me ha funcionado mucho,esta es mi tercera comprar,su formula es espectacular, su tamaño es bueno y la textura es divina ya que con una poca porción tu cara va ha estar 100% hidratada.
Lo ame me lo estoy acabando y ya voy por el segundo pote 10/10
Buscaba una crema que me ayudara a que la piel de mi cara de sintiera más fresca y humectada y lo logro. Además me generaron sensibilidad.

I couldn't find the large 200ml (6.76oz) of this on yesstyle so I ordered from Amazon. Initially, I was surprised to find the packaging was in all English. Usually my re-orders have been the Korean packaging with a translated sticker on it. I found someone else had posted the same English packaging on their bottle and they are in the EU. they received theirs from a legitimate source. I have scrutinized the font and packaging on the 200ml with my original 75ml bottle and it appears legit. So I am going to use it. It was also sealed and the ingredients match the smaller version. I have dry, flaky skin and this cream is my holy grail because the ato gel version is too lightweight, especially for winter. This cream is thicker but it is easy to apply and absorbs so nicely! Also fyi the new reformulation has rosemary leaf extract.

Es ultra hidratante, apto para pieles sensibles gracias a que no contiene fragancia, el contenido es muy bueno por el precio, ya que son 100ml, sus ingredientes son aptos para usar con otros activos como vitaminas y ácidos

I liked this cream when I put it on at night, I have mature normal skin, I woke up the next day, with a blemish that I didn't have the night before. It doesn't have a scent, and absorbs quickly. This cream has a lot of ingredients, which mostly seems to be obscure moisturizers. The ceramide is listed in the middle and near the bottom of the ingredients. This has soybean and canola oil in it. I think sometimes when we get Korean skin care we assume that it's better than most skin care. Not the case with this product for me.
